### Full Job Description
Summary:
Senior Backend Engineer building scalable backend services for LaunchDarkly’s software delivery and feature-management platform. Leading distributed systems, APIs, observability, and production reliability across engineering teams.
Senior Backend Engineer building reliable software delivery systems for LaunchDarkly’s feature-management platform
Role description:
• Design, build, test, and operate scalable, secure, observable, and maintainable production services and APIs
• Lead large or ambiguous backend projects from problem definition through delivery and iteration
• Make and communicate tradeoffs across scalability, performance, reliability, security, maintainability, cost, and delivery speed
• Identify architectural risks, performance bottlenecks, operational gaps, and technical friction, then drive improvements
• Improve system observability and operability through metrics, logs, traces, alerting, service-level objectives, and incident follow-through
• Collaborate with Product, Design, Support, Customer Success, Staff Engineers, Engineering Managers, and other engineering teams
• Influence technical direction through design documents, architecture discussions, code reviews, and communication
• Mentor engineers and contribute to inclusive collaboration and continuous improvement
• Participate in production support and incident response
• Develop reusable engineering patterns and developer experiences
Role requirements:
• 7+ years of experience building and operating production software
• Strong software engineering fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, testing, debugging, API design, and distributed-systems concepts
• Deep experience with a backend language such as Go, Python, Rust, or an equivalent language
• Experience designing reliable, observable, secure, and maintainable systems
• Ability to lead technical projects with ambiguous requirements, multiple stakeholders, or cross-team dependencies
• Sound judgment in architecture, technology choices, operational risk, and tradeoffs
• Ability to explain complex technical decisions clearly and align technical and non-technical partners
• Experience mentoring engineers and strengthening team practices
• Strong ownership of production outcomes and downstream customer impact
• Comfort learning unfamiliar systems and navigating changing priorities

Python, Rust, Go
